title: toona sinensis var. denticulata
intro: Toona sinensis var. denticulata, commonly known as Chinese Toona, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Toona include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
